rules.content:
/*
linkc ransomware
*/

rule linkc_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.linkc"
        description = "Detects linkc ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "linkc" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "LINKC" ascii
        $onion  = "linkc.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
